subtests.name:
grid-template-rows: none,
        grid-template-columns: none,
        grid-template-areas: none,
        grid-lanes-direction: column should be valid.

grid-template-rows: 10px,
        grid-template-columns: none,
        grid-template-areas: none,
        grid-lanes-direction: column should be valid.

grid-template-rows: 10px 20px,
        grid-template-columns: 10% 20%,
        grid-template-areas: none,
        grid-lanes-direction: row should be valid.

grid-template-rows: none,
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 3fr,
        grid-template-areas: "a a b",
        grid-lanes-direction: column should be valid.

grid-template-rows: 20% 40%,
        grid-template-columns: none,
        grid-template-areas: "b" "a",
        grid-lanes-direction: row should be valid.

grid-template-rows: none,
        grid-template-columns: fit-content(calc(0.5em + 10px)),
        grid-template-areas: none,
        grid-lanes-direction: column track-reverse fill-reverse should be valid.

grid-template-rows: 10% 20% 40%,
        grid-template-columns: none,
        grid-template-areas: "a" "b" "c",
        grid-lanes-direction: row fill-reverse track-reverse should be valid.

grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr),
        grid-template-columns: 10px 20px,
        grid-template-areas: "a b",
        grid-lanes-direction: normal should be valid.
grid-lanes: "a b" 100px column, then grid-template-areas: "c d"
grid-template-columns: 10px, grid-lanes-direction: column, then grid-lanes: row 100px
